name: Mitsubishi Pencil Co., Ltd.
summary: Mitsubishi Pencil Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies writing instruments in Japan, the United States, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company operates through Writing Instruments and Writing Instrument Peripheral Products Business; and Other Business segments. It offers pencils and colored pencils, water-based ink roller balls, oil-based ballpoint pens, mechanical pencils and refill lead, felt-tip pens and markers, and office and school supplies; and the sale of adhesive tape and handicrafts.
